description: From messy files to a checked report. A free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux: write and analyse with AI from your own files, check each sentence and figure against them, and export to Word. Meeting notes too. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or a local model through Ollama.
summary: IncarnaMind is a free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux where you ask questions about your own documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and more) and write with AI. Every answer cites the exact page, and IncarnaMind checks that each quoted passage is really there.
